title: Storage Beds with Drawers
descriptionHtml:
A storage bed with drawers keeps the mattress fixed and puts storage in pull-out drawers built into the base, so you can reach bedding or clothes without lifting anything. Handmade to order in Dewsbury, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Not quite right? For one large lifting compartment see ottoman beds, or compare everything in storage beds.

Drawer storage bed buying guide

Drawers or gas lift?

Choose drawers for everyday access, if lifting a mattress platform is awkward, or for a child's or teenager's room. Choose an ottoman gas-lift bed for the most space for bulky items you use less often.

In this range

  • Panel headboards — Cambridge, Oxford and Sussex Panel Storage Beds with Drawers.
  • Wingback — Oxford Wingback Storage Bed with Drawers.
  • Platform storage — Grey Button-Tufted Platform Storage Bed.
  • Base only — Divan Storage Base with Drawers, to pair with your own headboard.

Measuring up

Drawers need clear floor space in front of them to open fully, so measure the space beside or at the foot of the bed before you order. Check the drawer layout on each product page.

Sizes and fabrics

Made in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT), upholstered in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. See our UK bed sizes guide.

Frequently asked questions

Can the bed go against a wall?

Yes, as long as the side with the drawers has clear floor space to open them. Check the drawer positions on the product page.

Do I need a special mattress?

No. Any standard UK mattress in the matching size will fit.

How long does delivery take, and can I return a bed?

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging, and a faulty item is replaced free or fully refunded. See our returns policy.

What warranty do I get?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty. See our warranty page for the full terms.

Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire · solid wood frames · free delivery across Great Britain (Northern Ireland £90), usually in 3–5 working days · 14-day free returns · 5-year warranty · free fabric swatches · Klarna and Clearpay available.
